content.short: Silk Nodes runs a Monad hub for staking, validator comparison and ecosystem analytics.
content.description: Silk Nodes operates validator infrastructure on Monad and publishes a hub where delegators can compare validators before choosing one. Comparison tooling matters because delegation is usually decided on whichever validator is most visible, not whichever performs best.
content.meta: Validator operations on Monad plus a hub for comparing validators before delegating.
